business_summary: Jonjee Hi-Tech Industrial and Commercial Holding Co.,Ltd produces and sells seasoning products in China and internationally. The company offers soy sauce, chicken powder, oyster sauce, sauce, cooking wine, vinegar, edible oil, fermented bean curd, sauces, monosodium glutamate, and other seasoning products. It also provides property services, gardening, and housing brokerage services. In addition, the company engages in the property management, property leasing, property services, and various professional consulting services, as well as provides cleaning and greening maintenance, security, property maintenance and custody, and consulting services. Further, it involved in manufacturing and sale of precision forgings and machined products for automobiles and motorcycles. The company was formerly known as Zhongshan Torch Hi-tech Industrial & Commercial Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jonjee Hi-Tech Industrial and Commercial Holding Co.,Ltd in February 2001. Jonjee Hi-Tech Industrial and Commercial Holding Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Zhongshan, China.
business_summary_ko: Jonjee Hi-Tech Industrial and Commercial Holding Co.,Ltd는 중국 및 해외에서 조미료 제품을 생산 및 판매합니다. 간장, 치킨분말, 굴소스, 소스, 맛술, 식초, 식용유, 두부, 소스, 글루타민산나트륨 등 조미료 제품을 판매하고 있습니다. 또한 부동산 서비스, 정원 가꾸기, 주택 중개 서비스도 제공합니다. 또한 부동산 관리, 부동산 임대, 부동산 서비스, 각종 전문 컨설팅 서비스를 영위하고 있으며, 청소 및 녹화 유지관리, 보안, 부동산 유지관리 및 보관, 컨설팅 서비스도 제공하고 있습니다. 또한, 자동차 및 오토바이용 정밀 단조품 및 가공품의 제조 및 판매도 담당하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Zhongshan Torch Hi-tech Industrial and Commercial Co., Ltd.로 알려져 있었으며 2001년 2월에 Jonjee Hi-Tech Industrial and Commercial Holding Co.,Ltd로 이름을 변경했습니다. Jonjee Hi-Tech Industrial and Commercial Holding Co.,Ltd는 1993년에 설립되었으며 중국 중산에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
